question: what drives external line 0
finding: not visible in the firmware or the kext: the firmware routes line 0 to trigger 5 and listens; the host never touches META's trigger block. That line 0 is the MTS's thread-0 background request through the garten wrapper is inferred (it is the only non-timer line thread 0 listens on)

question: host-writable alternatives
finding: none found: no RGX register in the kext or firmware raises a META trigger besides MTS_SCHEDULE (0xb00); the trigger block 0x0482xxxx is reachable only through the slave port

question: enables on the path
finding: the firmware sets the DM association (0xb30/0xb40), the interrupt enables (0xb58..0xb78), the vectors and TXMASK. Apple's ConfigRAM list has SOFT_RESET, META_BOOT = 1 and 0x3800 plus 12 computed entries (unresolved). GARTEN_WRAPPER_CONFIG 0xb50 reads IDLE_CTRL = META (bit 0 = 0), as upstream sets it. No Fender or AIC enable on this path in the kext

question: MTS thread-active bits
finding: MTS_BGCTX 0xba0 THREAD_ACTIVE (bits 9:8) and MTS_INTCTX 0xb98 THREAD_ACTIVE (17:16) read 0 (run 70). If the MTS presents background work only to a thread it sees active, a thread asleep in TXSTAT would still count as idle and ready (inferred); no firmware access to these bits

question: interrupt-context kick
finding: CONTEXT bit 5 selects INTCTX; thread 0's INTCTX association is 0xffff (0xb40). The firmware registers an interrupt handler (0x80009970) for two contexts at MTS setup. An INTCTX kick may reach META on a different path from the background one (inferred)
